1.w: O my soul, bless YHWH! O YHWH my God, You are very great; with honor and majesty You are clothed.

2.w: Covering Himself [with] light as a garment, stretching out the heavens like a curtain,

3.w: the One laying the beams in the waters of His upper chambers, the One making the clouds His chariot, the One walking on the wings of the wind,

4.w: making the winds His messengers, His servants flaming fire.

5.w: He set the earth upon [its] foundations; it should not be shaken forever and ever.

6.w: The deep, as [with] a garment You covered it; upon the mountains the waters were standing.

7.w: From Your rebuke they fled; from the voice of Your thunder they hurried away.

8.w: Upon the mountains, the valleys sank down, to the place that You established for them.

9.w: You have set a boundary [that] they may not cross over; they may never return to cover the earth.

10.w: He sends the springs into the valleys; they flow between the hills.

11.w: They give drink to every beast of the field; the wild donkeys break their thirst.

12.w: Nearby them the birds of the heavens are dwelling; from between the branches they give forth a voice.

13.w: Watering the hills from His upper chambers; with the fruit of Your works the earth is satisfied—

14.w: causing the grass to sprout for the cattle, and vegetation for the service of man, to bring forth food from the earth,

15.w: and wine makes glad the heart of man, to make [his] face shine from oil, and bread supports the heart of man.

16.w: The trees of YHWH are satisfied, the cedars of Lebanon that He planted,

17.w: where in the birds make their nests; the stork—the cypresses [are] her house.

18.w: The high mountains [are] for the wild goats; the crags a refuge for the rock badgers.

19.w: He made the moon for appointed times; the sun knows its entrance.

20.w: You make darkness, and it becomes night; in it all the living [things] of the forest creep about.

21.w: The young lions roar for the prey and seek their food from God.

22.w: The sun rises, they are gathered; and in their dens they stretch out.

23.w: Man goes out to his work, and to his labor until the evening.

24.w: How many are Your works, O YHWH! All of them You have made in wisdom; the earth is full of Your creatures.

25.w: This [is] the sea, great and wide—in it [are] teeming things, and without number, living things small with the great.

26.w: There the ships go about, [and] Leviathan, which You formed to play in it.

27.w: All of them look to You, to give their food, in its season.

28.w: You give to them, [and] they gather in; You open Your hand, [and] they are satisfied [with] good.

29.w: You hide Your face—they are troubled; You gather their spirit—they die, and to their dust they return.

30.w: You send forth Your Spirit—they are created, and You renew the face of the earth.

31.w: May the glory of YHWH be forever; may YHWH rejoice in His works—

32.w: the One looking on the earth, and it trembles; He touches the mountains, and they smoke.

33.w: I will sing to YHWH during my life; I will sing praise to my God while I [live]!

34.w: May my melody be pleasing to Him; I rejoice in YHWH.

35.w: May the sinful ones be consumed from the earth, and the wicked shall not be anymore! O my soul, bless YHWH! Hallelu YAH!
